entries.name: Morning Tide
offer_text: You're awake! Good. The river's been muttering all night.
Fetch the three teas I left about the hut, then look in your bag so you know where things are.
Then out you go. Lu wants you at the docks.
complete_text: There. Now go on, Lu's waiting.
progress_text: Three teas. One on the table, one on the shelf, one by the stove.

entries.name: A Quiet River

objectives.text: Find Lu at the Ferry Docks

complete_text: You're up. The river is too quiet. Fish gone deep, birds gone high.
Help the village while I watch the water. Little Dou lost his kite, Old Ma needs a hand, Granny Liu has something for you, and Guo wants to see your fists.
Come back when you've done all four. Gold marks mean the story. Blue mean lessons.

entries.name: The Runaway Kite

objectives.text: Fetch the kite from the Ferry Inn roof

offer_text: My kite! It flew onto the inn roof! The big one!
Climb the ladder on the Village Hall, then jump across. Or jump from the stall awning!
complete_text: My kite! You're the best! Here, I saved this rice ball. It's only a bit squashed.
progress_text: Ladder, hall roof, then jump onto the inn. You can do it!

entries.name: Aunt Ping's Ladle

objectives.text: Fetch Aunt Ping's ladle from the hut roof

offer_text: The gulls took my ladle again. It's on the hut roof, glinting at me.
There's a ladder by the door. Mind the edge.
complete_text: My ladle! I'd have made soup with a spoon for a week.

entries.name: Ma's Delivery

objectives.text: Sell the Old Net to Old Ma

offer_text: Aunt Ping's old net has been in my way for a month. It's under the shelf. Sell it back to me, fair and square.
Then buy two rice balls. That's how trade works: you give, you get.
complete_text: See? Coins go round like the river. Here's a little for your trouble.

entries.name: Granny's Remedy

objectives.text: Put Herbal Tea in the Quick-use slot

offer_text: Hold still, child. Herbal Tea. Put it where your hand finds it without looking.
Drink one. Then bow at the shrine in the square. It remembers those who visit.
complete_text: Good. The shrine will patch you up when you're hurt. Tea when you can't reach it.

entries.name: Race to the Tower
offer_text: Race you to the watch tower bell. Loser guts tomorrow's fish.
Hold the joystick all the way over to sprint. Go!
complete_text: What?! ...Fine. Fleet-Footed. Don't let it go to your head.
entries.fail_text: Too slow! Talk to Shen Lian to try again.

entries.name: Fists First

objectives.text: Hit the dummy after its wind-up

offer_text: Fists first! Jab, cross, jab. Hold the button and they flow.
Twelve on the stump. Then the dummy: watch it lean back before it swings. Hit it then.
complete_text: Not bad! The East Gate's open for you. Reed Shallows. Crabs. You'll see.
progress_text: Elbow in! Twelve on the stump, five on the dummy.

entries.name: A Quiet River (Return)
complete_text: Kite, net, tea and fists. The village thanks you.
Guo's fretting about the crabs in the Reed Shallows. Too many, too angry. Go and see him.

entries.name: Crab Trouble
offer_text: The crabs came up the shallows in the night. Dozens. Something's pushing them out of the river.
Bring me five shells. And if the big one shows, Old Snapper, watch its claw: step up or down when it rears back.
complete_text: Old Snapper! Ha! Here, fifty taels and my old straw hat. Wear it, it keeps the sun out of a fighter's eyes.

entries.name: Evening on the River

objectives.text: Meet Lu at the docks at sunset

offer_text: Eat with your aunt tonight. Then come to the docks at sunset. There's something I want to show you on the water.

objectives.text: Get Little Dou to the hut
Get Granny Liu to the hut
Get Old Ma to the hut

entries.name: The River Token
offer_text: That thing in the water was a Hollowed eel. The grey is spreading.
You have a gift. I felt it last night. Sit. Breathe as I showed you.
complete_text: Bone Forging. Your first step. The body is the cup; Qi will be the water.
Take this River Token. Go west along the Willow Path. There's a note waiting for you.

entries.name: The Willow Path
complete_text: (A note in Lu's hand) Good. Now Stoneford. The sects are recruiting at the Fairground.

entries.name: The Recruitment Fair

objectives.text: Speak to the Jade Sect recruiter
Speak to the Cloud Sect recruiter

offer_text: The Recruitment Fair! Both sects take new service disciples this week.
Speak to both of us before you choose. The choice is for life.
complete_text: Welcome, disciple. Now pass the Entry Trial.

entries.name: Entry Trial
complete_text: Service Disciple! Report to the steward at your sect's gate.

entries.name: A Disciple's Chores
offer_text: Service disciples sweep. Three spots on the street. The grey dust gets everywhere these days.
complete_text: Clean enough. Your bunk is in the dorm: rest there any time.

entries.name: Fish-Gutting Fists

objectives.text: Beat Shen Lian in a spar

offer_text: Cloud Sect taught me more in a week than the river did in ten years. Spar me.
complete_text: ...Fine. You won. This time. Don't get lazy.

entries.name: The Weapon Hall

objectives.text: Take a training weapon from the rack

offer_text: Three training weapons: jian, spear, gauntlets. Try them on the dummies. Keep the one that feels like your own arm.
Guard is the other half of a weapon. Hold it up when they swing.
complete_text: Good hands. The weapon Dao grows with every strike. The smiths sell better ones in Stoneford.

entries.name: Eyes for Qi

objectives.text: Meditate by a Qi spring or glowing spot

offer_text: You're starting to feel Qi in the air. Sit and let it show itself.
Willow Moss grows in the Reed Shallows. Pick three: Mei Qing will want them.
complete_text: You see it now. The valley glows, faintly, everywhere.

entries.name: Outer Trial

objectives.text: Win spars at the practice posts
Climb a roof and Plunge to the practice ground

offer_text: Outer disciples are chosen by their fists. Win three spars at the practice posts.
And learn to come down hard. From any height, pull down and strike: we call it Plunge. Show me once, from a roof.
complete_text: Outer Disciple. You'll get a proper robe soon.

entries.name: Leaf on the Wind

objectives.text: Climb the vine and glide over the pool

offer_text: Watch a leaf fall from Crane Falls. It never hurries. Hold your breath, hold the jump, and fall like that.
Climb the vine beside the falls and glide over the pool. The spray will carry you if you let it.
complete_text: You came down like a leaf, not a stone. Good.

entries.name: Swallow Dart

objectives.text: Dart through the air three times

offer_text: The first floor keeps a slim scroll: Swallow Dart. A swallow turns in the air without touching anything.
Jump, then tap Evade. You will hang for a breath and dart ahead. Three times, and mind the shelves.
complete_text: Once per leap, remember. Even swallows land.

entries.name: Stone and Sweat
offer_text: Take my old pickaxe. Five copper, five beetles. And dodge the imps' pebbles, they sting.
complete_text: You'll make a miner yet. Here, an iron pick. Mind your toes.

entries.name: A Second Path

objectives.text: Create a second character or set an idle task

offer_text: (A letter from your mentor) One cultivator can't walk every road. Train a second disciple, or leave this one to train while you rest.

entries.name: Earning Your Keep
offer_text: Missions. Five a day. Hunt, gather, deliver. Contribution buys what money can't.
complete_text: The contribution shop is open to you now.

entries.name: The First Current

objectives.text: Meditate in the Lotus Ferry Qi spring

offer_text: You feel it, don't you? A current inside. That's Qi. Your cup can hold water now.
The old spring by Granny Liu's hut has woken. Sit in it. Then learn to cultivate while you sleep.
complete_text: Your first current. Don't let it flood you.

entries.name: Aunt Ping's Broth
offer_text: You look thin! Here, my old pot and your uncle's rod. Two fish from the docks, two cuts of boar, and we'll make broth.
complete_text: Now that's a broth. You'll feed yourself properly now, won't you?

entries.name: The Wall

objectives.text: Meditate until your Qi is full

offer_text: Bone Forging 9. Every realm ends in a wall. Look at it. Read what it asks.
complete_text: Walls are only lists. Work down the list.

entries.name: First Technique
offer_text: Qi Kindling. Now your Qi can leave your body. Flowing Palm: push Qi through the palm. Twenty times.
complete_text: The technique remembers you now. Train it and it grows.

entries.name: Mei Qing's Furnace
offer_text: You have Qi enough to feed a furnace. Take this little bronze one. Healing Pills: willow moss and patience.
complete_text: Three pills. None of them exploded. You're a natural.

entries.name: Stones That Move You
offer_text: Touch the stones and they'll remember you. A shard pays the way.
complete_text: Travel lighter now. The valley's smaller than you thought.

entries.name: Listening to the Waterfall
offer_text: Some places teach. The Falls Pool teaches Water. Sit by the insight stone and listen.
complete_text: You heard it. Insight grows the Dao; the Dao shapes the technique.

entries.name: Two Hands Full

objectives.text: Defeat the Thicket Heart elite together

offer_text: Four disciples of your year are looking for a partner. Pick one. Then prove it in the Thicket Heart.
complete_text: Two can walk where one would fall. Your technique slots have grown too.

entries.name: Is It Real?
offer_text: Here's a loupe. Look at three things and tell me what they really are. Half the valley's jade is glass.
complete_text: Good eye. Keep it. The wandering merchant Old Pan will trade with you now.

entries.name: The Caravan Road
offer_text: My carts go missing on the Caravan Road. Mudwater bandits. Thin them out and find their key.
complete_text: The Hideout. Take the key; clear the place and my carts roll again.

entries.name: Batch Work
offer_text: You can't stand at the furnace all day. Queue a batch and come back.
complete_text: Here's a drying rack for herbs. Batches go faster with dry ingredients.

entries.name: Toward Cleansing Peak
offer_text: Qi Kindling 9. The next wall is Heaven's Cleansing: heaven washes the impurities out of you. Or tries.
Climb the Pilgrim Stairs. The guardians test who may approach the summit.
complete_text: The summit is open to you. Prepare Cleansing Pills before the rite.

entries.name: After the Cleansing
offer_text: Qi Unfurling. Your Qi can fly now. Send it at a target ten times.
complete_text: Inner Disciple. A retreat room is yours; the door is past the mission hall.

entries.name: Ink and Paper

objectives.text: Write a Flame Talisman at Old Scribe Bai's table

offer_text: Paper, cinnabar and one clean stroke. That is all a talisman is, and all it ever will be.
Trace the character without lifting your hand. Smooth and unhurried makes a strong one; a broken stroke spoils the paper.
complete_text: Not bad for a first. Here: the rest of my book. Beast-blood ink for the stronger ones; spirit paper for anything that must hold.

entries.name: The Sect Forge
offer_text: A disciple with Qi in their hands can work the sect forge. Take this hammer. Forge something, then make it better.
complete_text: An Earth blueprint. Don't waste the Jadeiron.

entries.name: Seeds of the Valley
offer_text: Plant, water, harvest. Three beds.
complete_text: You've got green hands.

entries.name: A Friend in the Reeds
offer_text: Three young ones came to me after the grey took their mothers. An otter, a fox and a crane chick. One will choose you.
complete_text: Feed it, fight beside it, and it'll grow.

entries.name: Full Hands

objectives.text: Raise a technique to mastery tier 4

offer_text: Eight slots now. But a technique used a thousand times beats eight used once. Tier 4.
complete_text: Here, a manual page. Pages push mastery past what practice alone can.

entries.name: The Riverbed Serpent
offer_text: The notice board's been screaming about it: the Riverbed Serpent surfaces in Serpent's Shallows every 45 minutes. Stand on the high rocks.
complete_text: The serpent's core. Alchemists will pay well; better still, keep it.

entries.name: Calming the Wild
offer_text: Wild ones wander the valley now: otters in the marsh, foxes in the bamboo, crane chicks at the falls. Calm one.
complete_text: It trusts you. Don't make me regret it.

entries.name: The Bracket
offer_text: Cloud Stride, and a qualifier behind you. The bracket's open: two more wins puts you in the top eight.
Top eight means core disciple. The elders are watching.
complete_text: Top eight. Core disciple. The third floor of the library is yours.

entries.name: The Valley Finals
offer_text: Finals. Three bouts, no rest between. Win and the valley knows your name.
complete_text: Valley Champion. Wear it lightly.

entries.name: The Valley Tournament (Qualifier)
offer_text: Three wins and you're in the Valley Tournament.
complete_text: You're in. The bracket opens at Cloud Stride.

entries.name: The Quiet Heart
offer_text: The Heart Trial will show you yourself. Practise stillness first. Five minutes, no backlash.
complete_text: Still water. Take this incense for the real trial.

entries.name: Lines in the Sand

objectives.text: Place and fuel a gathering formation

offer_text: Three nodes, one centre, fuel in each. A gathering formation thickens Qi around you.
complete_text: Lines hold. Formations are patience made visible.

entries.name: Cloud Ladder

objectives.text: Double jump to three high ledges

offer_text: This scroll is older than the sect: Cloud Ladder Step. Press off the air itself, once, at the top of a jump.
Try it now. Three ledges you could not reach before, and tell me what the valley looks like from there.
complete_text: Now you understand why the old masters built their halls so high.

entries.name: Between Two Walls

objectives.text: Climb the Echo Cliffs shaft with Wall-Step
Defeat Mist Vultures on the top tier

offer_text: Two walls close together are a ladder, if you are light enough. Push into one, kick, and reach for the other.
Climb the shaft at the Echo Cliffs. The vultures nest at the top; clear three.
complete_text: Three kicks and you were above them. Good. Height is a weapon.

entries.name: A Treasure in Hand

objectives.text: Ring the Practice Bell in a fight

offer_text: A cultivator carries more than a blade. Take this Practice Bell; it sits in your Treasure button.
Ring it three times when foes press close. Feel what a treasure costs you.
complete_text: Keep the bell. Better treasures wait in the valley: drowned bells, jade pagodas, mirrors that throw back arrows.

entries.name: The Infirmary
offer_text: Needles, pills and a gentle hand. Three patients.
complete_text: Healing is cultivation turned outward.

entries.name: Carry a Wall
offer_text: A formation you can carry. Etch one plate.
complete_text: Take these blanks.

entries.name: Skipping Stones

objectives.text: Sprint across the pond under the stilt house
Pick the Mist Lotus on the pond's rock

offer_text: A stone skips if it is fast and flat. So can you. Sprint at the pond and do not stop.
A Mist Lotus grows on the rock in the middle. Stop on the water and you'll be fishing yourself out.
complete_text: Wet to the knees only. The otters are impressed.

entries.name: The Warm Egg
offer_text: An egg, warm and humming. Keep it close.
complete_text: Another life in your care.

entries.name: Brothers in Arms
offer_text: The gorge is too much for two. Take a second companion.
complete_text: Three together. Good.

entries.name: Keep Watch

objectives.text: Break through a stage inside a guard formation

offer_text: A guard formation around you while you break through: nothing interrupts, nothing surprises.
complete_text: Safe and stronger.

entries.name: The Heart Trial
offer_text: Step into the circle on my peak. What comes out of the mirror is you. Beat it.
Take this: Elder Hu's Heaven-Splitting Palm, folded into paper. Three charges. Set it in a Treasure button and keep it for the worst moment.
complete_text: You looked yourself in the eye and didn't blink. Cloud Stride awaits.

entries.name: Wings of Cloud

objectives.text: Take to the air: hold Jump as you start to fall

offer_text: Cloud Stride. Your Qi can carry you. The cranes of the cliffs will teach you the rest.
complete_text: The sky is a road now.

entries.name: Riding the Wind

objectives.text: Bond with your spirit animal again
Ride it: Spirit Animals, choose Mount

offer_text: A big enough friend can carry you.
complete_text: Hold on tight.
And when there is no friend, here: an old sword that remembers how to fly. Stand on the flat of it.

entries.name: Clearer Water
offer_text: Impure Qi clouds everything. Refine it in seclusion.
complete_text: Clearer. Purer. Stronger.

entries.name: Above the Mist
offer_text: Up. Higher. The hawks nest on the Sky Ledges.
complete_text: Cloud Descent: fall on them like weather.

entries.name: The Upper Stacks
offer_text: Floor 3 is for core disciples.
complete_text: Mind the dust. Some manuals bite.

entries.name: Hands of Wood
offer_text: A puppet that gathers while you cultivate. Here's wood and a core; build one at my bench.
complete_text: Look at it go!

entries.name: Opening the Lake

objectives.text: Refine the Mind Lake Opening Pill

offer_text: Spirit Awakening needs a mind lake. This pill opens it.
complete_text: Take it when you're ready to wake.

entries.name: A Lake Inside
offer_text: Your soul has a lake now. Pulse it outward: Spirit Sense.
complete_text: The world has more in it than eyes see.

entries.name: What the Eyes Miss
offer_text: Hidden doors all over the valley. Sense them. Use them.
complete_text: Concealment: be what the eyes miss.

entries.name: The Sleeping Blade

objectives.text: Take the Sleeping Blade from its altar
Bind it (Bag: tap the blade, Bind; stand clear of blows)

offer_text: The Abbot's vault holds a blade that sleeps. Your soul can wake it.
complete_text: It chose you. Treat it well.

entries.name: Quiet Waters
offer_text: Souls tire. Rest yours.
complete_text: Soul Soothing Pills, for the worst days.

entries.name: The Mentor's Gift
offer_text: Beat my best disciple and I'll teach you personally.
complete_text: My personal disciple. My secret art is yours, and the cave behind the pagoda is your abode.

entries.name: Treasures of Heaven and Earth

objectives.text: Pick the Mindwell Lotus behind Crane Falls
Plant the Evergreen Heart seed in rich earth (the elder's peak, your cave abode or the Back Mountain)

offer_text: Heaven and earth grow a few things that are worth more than pills. Never sell them.
A lotus that shields the soul. A tree whose fruit lifts you from death's edge. Take this seed.
complete_text: Good. One more: at the Forgotten Monastery stands the Nine-Bough Jade Tree.
When your understanding stalls at a wall, sit beneath it. Only then will it answer.

entries.name: Torn Pages
offer_text: Restore a manual. Ink, patience, insight.
complete_text: You gave a dead technique back its voice.

entries.name: Passing It On
offer_text: Teach, and learn twice.
complete_text: You'll make a fine elder.

entries.name: A Wider Sky

objectives.text: Meditate by the heaven insight stone

offer_text: Heaven Glimpse. There's a stone at the Forgotten Monastery where the sky leans close.
complete_text: You glimpsed it. Now the valley feels small.

entries.name: Beyond the Valley

objectives.text: Follow Lu's map to the Frozen Shrine on Summit Ridge

offer_text: Heaven Glimpse 3. The valley can't hold you any more. Here: my old map.
The way out runs past the Frozen Shrine. Walk it once, then come back and tell me what you saw.
complete_text: The Gate is past the shrine, then. Before you go, the village will want to see you.

entries.name: Farewells
offer_text: Say your farewells. Aunt Ping first, or she'll never forgive either of us.
complete_text: Good. Now go. The river will still be here.

entries.name: Strange Tracks

objectives.text: Investigate grey patches in the Reed Marsh

offer_text: Disciples report grey patches in the Reed Marsh. Colour drained from the reeds. Look, but touch nothing.
complete_text: Hollowing. It's closer than we hoped.

entries.name: The Humming Token

objectives.text: Follow the token to the Grey Pools

offer_text: Your River Token hums when you face east. Follow it.
complete_text: Lu's token. It knows the grey. Keep it close.

entries.name: Mei Qing's Errand
offer_text: The Hollowed wounds need a new salve. Willow moss and copper dust.
complete_text: This will save lives. Thank you.

entries.name: Grey at the Edges
offer_text: Tell me everything you saw.

entries.name: Bandits on the Road
offer_text: The Caravan Road's a bandit den. Ten of them, and Stoneford breathes easier.
complete_text: Good work. The Mudwater won't forget you.

entries.name: Gu's Cargo

objectives.text: Escort the cart to Bend Shore

offer_text: One cart, one road, one bodyguard. You.
complete_text: Every crate intact. You'll go far.

entries.name: Mudwater Hideout
offer_text: Tan runs the Mudwater from the hideout. End him.
complete_text: The road's safe. Stoneford owes you.

entries.name: The Rite
offer_text: Stand in the circle at the summit. Let heaven wash you.
complete_text: You saw someone in the light. A man with a river in his eyes. Yan Heng...

entries.name: The Shrine Surfaces
offer_text: The Drowned Shrine has risen at Deepwater Bend. Lu's handwriting is on the old maps.
complete_text: Go deeper.

entries.name: Lu's Handwriting
offer_text: Find what Lu wrote.
complete_text: Lu was here. Long before you were born.

entries.name: The Riverbreath Trial

objectives.text: Pass Lu's inheritance trial at the Scripture Well

offer_text: Lu left more than words down there. An inheritance tests the one who claims it.
Stand in the stone ring by the well and hold while the drowned rise. Breathe with the river.
complete_text: The well accepted you. Now only the Abbot stands between you and Lu's method.

entries.name: The Drowned Abbot
offer_text: The Abbot guards the Riverbreath inheritance. Ring his four bells to silence him.
complete_text: The full Riverbreath. Lu's own method.

entries.name: Quiet Before the Storm
offer_text: Heart Tempering tests Composure. Train where the water never rests.
complete_text: Steadier. Good.

entries.name: Shen Lian's Failure
offer_text: I failed the Heart Trial. I saw... never mind. Fight me. I need to hit something that hits back.
complete_text: Thanks. Don't fail yours.

entries.name: Hidden Cargo

objectives.text: Use Spirit Sense in the warehouse district

offer_text: (A sealed note) Gu is smuggling Hollow shards. Sense the warehouses.
complete_text: Hollow shards. Crates of them.

entries.name: Gu's Warehouse
offer_text: Raid the warehouse. Take his ledger.
complete_text: He fled through a Tide rift. The ledger will do.

entries.name: The Rift
offer_text: Madam Hua takes over the trade house. Tell her what you found.
complete_text: Thank you. The trade house will be honest now.

entries.name: Allies at the Wall
offer_text: Both sects will stand together. Build the wall formations.
complete_text: The wall holds. For now.

entries.name: The Siege

objectives.text: Survive the Siege of Two Sects

offer_text: They're coming. Hollow waves, and something huge.
complete_text: We held.

entries.name: What Remains
complete_text: I'm still here. Because you cleared every defence. Thank you.

entries.name: Nets and Shells
offer_text: The crabs cut my nets to ribbons. Bring me their shells and I'll patch the nets with them. Fair's fair.
complete_text: Ha! Crab-shell floats. They'll never live it down. Here, supper.

entries.name: The Muddy Wash

objectives.text: Chase the Reedtail Rats off the washing lines

offer_text: Rats in the reeds again. They chew the lines and drag the washing through the mud. Six of them, at least.
complete_text: Clean sheets for once. Bless you.

entries.name: Beetle Shell Lacquer
offer_text: Ground beetle shell makes the finest lacquer in the valley. The quarry beetles are too tough for my porters.
complete_text: Look at that shine. The Jade Sect will pay double for boxes like these.

entries.name: Copper for the Bellows
offer_text: My bellows need new copper fittings and the quarry price doubled. Mine me some, would you?
complete_text: Good ore. Take my old hammer. It still rings true.

entries.name: Auntie Rong's Soup
offer_text: My hands shake too much to gut fish these days. Two bowls of riverfish soup for my grandsons?
complete_text: Just like my mother made. Take some tea, dear.

entries.name: Kai's Wager

objectives.text: Defeat Mud Hounds at the Mudwater stockade

offer_text: I bet Rui you could clear the stockade kennels before I could. Don't make me lose.
complete_text: Ha! Rui owes me a month of dumplings. Here's your cut.

entries.name: Su Qing's Map
offer_text: I'm charting the gorge for the cartographers' guild. The serpents on the Echo Cliffs keep eating my surveyors' lunch.
complete_text: The ledge is clear. My map will have your name in the corner.

entries.name: Min's First Caravan

objectives.text: Clear the gorge bandits from the caravan road

offer_text: Greyreed's first caravan leaves for Stoneford tomorrow. The gorge bandits know it too.
complete_text: The caravan made it! Greyreed is a real trade post now.

entries.name: Wen Zhao's Challenge

objectives.text: Beat Wen Zhao in a rematch

offer_text: The finals were luck. Face me again, here, with no crowd to cheer for you.
complete_text: ...Not luck, then. Next time I'll be ready.

entries.name: Guo's Old Wound
offer_text: My old meridian wound aches. Granny's salve helps.
complete_text: Ahh. Better.

entries.name: The Broken Kindling
offer_text: I want to try again. Kindling. Help me?
complete_text: We'll see.

entries.name: A Second Try
offer_text: Stay with me while I try.
complete_text: Qi Kindling 1. At my age! Ha!

entries.name: Dou's Kite Returns

objectives.text: Bring a Cloud Feather for the new kite

offer_text: I'm making a kite that flies to the clouds! I need a cloud feather.
complete_text: It flies! Sort of!

entries.name: Dou Wants to Train

objectives.text: Show Dou how to punch the stump

offer_text: Teach me to punch! Please please please.
complete_text: Hi-YAH! Did you see?!

entries.name: Grey Roofs

objectives.text: Clear the Hollowed from the Grey Pools

offer_text: Clear the pools and we can walk home.
complete_text: The road home is open.

entries.name: Cleansing the Well
offer_text: The well. If it runs clear, we stay.
complete_text: Clear water. Thank you.

entries.name: Market Day
offer_text: A market needs goods. Rice to start.
complete_text: Greyreed trades again!

entries.name: Old Pan's First Errand
offer_text: Peppers. Five.
complete_text: Spicy. Good.

entries.name: Old Pan's Second Errand
offer_text: A pearl. From the tide crabs.
complete_text: Lovely.

entries.name: Old Pan's Third Errand
offer_text: Mist lotus. Two.
complete_text: I'll keep something special for you from now on.

entries.name: The Herb Thief
offer_text: Lan Yue has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Lan Yue smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: A Cure for Stoneford
offer_text: Lan Yue has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Lan Yue smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: Lan Yue's Oath
offer_text: Lan Yue has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Lan Yue smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: Iron Ox's Debt
offer_text: Tie Niu has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Tie Niu smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: The Quarry Fight
offer_text: Tie Niu has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Tie Niu smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: Stronger Than Stone
offer_text: Tie Niu has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Tie Niu smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: The Missing Hunter
offer_text: Qiu Feng has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Qiu Feng smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: Crane Falls at Dawn

objectives.text: Visit the Falls Pool at dawn

offer_text: Qiu Feng has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Qiu Feng smiles. "Thank you."

offer_text: Qiu Feng has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Qiu Feng smiles. "Thank you."

offer_text: Bai Ling has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Bai Ling smiles. "Thank you."

offer_text: Bai Ling has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Bai Ling smiles. "Thank you."

offer_text: Bai Ling has a favour to ask.
complete_text: Bai Ling smiles. "Thank you."

entries.name: A Hall of Our Own
offer_text: (A letter) The Hidden Vale beyond Crane Falls could hold a sect. Yours.

entries.name: First Recruits
offer_text: A sect needs people.

entries.name: Walls of the Vale
offer_text: Defend the Vale.

entries.name: Through the Gate

objectives.text: Speak with the toll warden on the Arrival Terrace

complete_text: Valley-born, by the mud on your boots. No toll for your first step. There will be for every other.
Welcome to Cloudgate Port, gateway of the Nine Peaks Alliance.

entries.name: A Sky Full of Toll Roads

objectives.text: Meet the Alliance factor in the Port Market
Find the free broker at the Wayfarers' Inn

offer_text: No papers, no road. The Factor sells Alliance goods in the market. The broker at the inn sells... other things.
Talk to both. Then decide what kind of cultivator you mean to be up here.
complete_text: The Factor told you the price of a road. I'll tell you the price of the sky: your blood.
The plains' storms pull Qi out of anyone who hasn't attuned to them. Sit. Let me show you.

entries.name: Storm in the Blood

objectives.text: Raise your Storm Ward jades (Character, Attunement tab)
Hunt Spark Weasels on the Stormgrass Verge

offer_text: Four jades, cut from storm-glass. Carry them and feed them the shards the storm leaves in its beasts.
The more you feed them, the less the storm feeds on you. Start on the Verge. Weasels. Small, quick, angry.
complete_text: See? You flinch less. Keep feeding the jades; the land further out asks for more.
One more thing, free: the alchemist in the Condensing Hall can make a Sage of you. She'll want thunder.

entries.name: Horns for the Furnace

objectives.text: Bring Thunderhorn horns from the Flats

offer_text: Heaven Glimpse 3, and you want to be a Sage. Everyone does.
The condensing needs thunder. Three thunderhorn horns from the Flats. I'll press them into your pill.
complete_text: There. Swallow it here, where the Qi is thick. Not in a field with a rhino watching.
And take my old cauldron. Nine dragons, and every one of them drinks heat. My hands shake too much for it now.

entries.name: Sage

objectives.text: Break through to Sage 1 (third-grade purity, the pill, a land that can hold you)

offer_text: Purity of the third grade, the pill, and a land that can hold you. The Expanse can.
Sit on the mat. Breathe until the True Qi turns to light.
complete_text: Sage Qi. Feel how it moves? Like thunder that learned its manners.
The Nine Peaks will want your name now. So will people who are worse than the Alliance.

entries.name: Shards for Sale

objectives.text: Ask Old Suo about the grey buyer
Follow the buyer's tracks across the Lightning Scar
Catch up with the stranger on Frostpine Climb

offer_text: Someone is buying Hollow shards across the Expanse. Grey robes, no shadow at noon.
The herders have seen him on the plains. Old Suo misses nothing. Start there.
complete_text: He let you catch him. That's worse than if he'd run.
If he went up into the snow, only one person up there would have seen him: the hermit of Rimefrost.

entries.name: Frost and Silence

objectives.text: Find the hermit's cave on Rimefrost Summit (Spirit Sense shows hidden ways)
Sit in silence in the Ice Cave

offer_text: The hermit lives somewhere on Rimefrost Summit. People who look for him don't find him.
People who stop looking sometimes do.
complete_text: ...You can sit still. Good. Most who climb up here only want to talk.
The grey one passed a month ago. He stopped at the lake. The lake remembers everything. Ask it.

entries.name: The Mirror Remembers

objectives.text: Take the sky-ship to Mirrorwater Lake and reach the Lake Shrine
Look into the shrine's bronze mirror
Silence the Thousand-Eye Toad in Toad's Hollow

offer_text: The mirror at the Lake Shrine shows what the lake has seen. The toad in the hollow drinks the reflections.
Look into the mirror. Then quiet the toad, or the lake will forget everything it knows.
complete_text: In the mirror: the grey one kneeling at the shore, feeding Hollow shards to the water. And behind him, older,
a young ferryman with a river-green token at his belt. Lu. The lake remembered him too.

entries.name: Nine Seats

objectives.text: Take the sky-ship to Nine Peaks and enter the Hall of Nine
Take an Alliance seat, or keep the free road

offer_text: An invitation came with the morning ship. Nine Peaks wants to see you. They see everyone who crosses, sooner or later.
The Alliance will offer you a seat. The broker will tell you why you shouldn't take it. Both are right.
complete_text: Whichever you chose, choose it every day. The Hollow shards are coming from somewhere inside the Expanse.
The canyons east of here are where they pass. Go and see who is paying the tolls.

entries.name: Going Once

objectives.text: Place a bid at the Auction Pavilion

offer_text: First time at the block? Pick a lot, name a price. The other bidders will tell you if you're wrong.
complete_text: There. Win or lose, you're a bidder now. The Pavilion opens new lots every dawn.

entries.name: The Canyon Toll

objectives.text: Ask the tollkeeper at the Canyon Mouth who pays in shards
Break the veiled brigands' hold on the canyon
Cross the Windbridge to Ironroot Hold

offer_text: Someone pays the canyon toll in Hollow shards. The tollkeeper takes them because they spend like stones.
Follow the shards east. The veiled brigands carry them for someone.
complete_text: You crossed the Windbridge with brigand blood on your boots. The Hold has been watching them too.
The Matriarch will want to meet you. She doesn't want to meet many.

entries.name: Ironroot Blood

objectives.text: Pass the warden's test of root
Honour the ancestral tablets in the Ancestor Hall

offer_text: Kin is not given at the gate. Show me your root holds, then the Matriarch decides.
complete_text: The ancestors did not object. That is as close to a welcome as they give.
You are Ironroot now, in the Hold and on the roads. Our forge is yours. So are our quarrels.

entries.name: Glass and Bone

objectives.text: Follow the desert road past the Clan Hearth to the Oasis of Bones
Clear the Sandstorm Scorpions from the caravan road
Ask the bone-reader about the Pilgrim's caravan

offer_text: Our scouts saw the Grey Pilgrim's caravan turn south into the Sunscar. Nobody goes there for trade anymore.
Take the desert road past the Hearth. Find the Oasis of Bones. Its diviner sees what the sand hides.
complete_text: A grey man with no shadow, buying water and asking about the tomb? The bones spoke of him before you did.
He wants the sun seal. The Tomb King took it into the dark with him, three thousand years ago.

entries.name: The Sealed Gate

objectives.text: Cut the pieces of the sun seal's key out of the Dune Worms of the Worm Sea
Find the Sealed Gate beyond the Worm Sea
Fit the pieces to the gate and read its inscription

offer_text: The gate answers a key of gold and jade, and the worms swallowed that key in pieces when the tomb was sealed.
Three pieces. Then read the inscription on the gate, if your eyes can hold it. It is written for scholars, not thieves.
complete_text: The doors are open? Then do not go in. Not yet. He was a Sage Sovereign, and a Sage who walks into his hall joins his guard.
Take this pill for after. First, become what he was.

entries.name: The Tomb King

objectives.text: Pass the Hall of Sand Kings into the Mirror Crypt
Find what Lu left in the crypt
Face the Tomb King of Sunscar on his throne
Keep the seal from the Grey Pilgrim

offer_text: Now you can go in. The King sealed himself in with the seal. Whoever holds it can open what the Hollow keeps shut.
The grey man will be waiting on the stairs. He always is.
complete_text: You came back, and the Pilgrim did not come back with you. The bones say that is enough for today.
Lu's page... he stood where you stood, and he walked away without the seal. You chose your own way. Good.

entries.name: Sovereign

objectives.text: Break through to Sage Sovereign 1 (a full Sage Qi reserve and one Dao at Adaptation)

offer_text: The Tomb King was a Sage Sovereign. His land still holds the Qi for it. Fill your reserve and let one Dao adapt to you.
Then sit by the water and break through. The Settling Pill will hold the new stage steady.
complete_text: Sage Sovereign. The sand bends a little when you breathe now. Did you notice?
The Pilgrim noticed too. Whatever he serves has been waiting for someone like you to come this far.

entries.name: Gu's Ledger

objectives.text: Ask Broker Mu who sells pages of a valley ledger
Ask Navigator Sun at the Shipwrights' Yard about the Starsea

offer_text: A lot came in this morning that I would not sell: one page of a smuggler's ledger. Valley family names, and what each paid him.
The seller fled on a skiff with no flag, out toward the Starsea. Your valley's names. I thought you would want to know.
complete_text: The Skyport Wreck. Pirates of the comet sails nest there now, where the old port broke on the edge of the Starsea.
Nobody walks there. You sail, or you stay. I can teach you to chart the way; Lao can build you something to sail in.

entries.name: The Skyport Wreck

objectives.text: Chart the Wreck Run at Navigator Sun's table
Build a vessel on Shipwright Lao's slipway
Sail the Wreck Run to the Skyport Wreck
Take back the ledger pages the pirates carry
Find the seller on the Pirate Deck

offer_text: Four readings and two measures of sky ink make the Wreck Run. The sighting stones are here, on Rimefrost Summit and on the Presence Terrace.
Then a hull. Lao is waiting. When you are over the Starsea, trust the chart, not your eyes.
complete_text: Gu. Of course it was Gu. And the comet sails did not take his ledger for the valley's pennies.
They took it for the names of three of our own peaks' disciples, who sold them the Gate's watch rota. The Gate is next.

entries.name: Sect War

objectives.text: Strike the war gong at the Alliance Gate and hold the Gate against the comet sails
Decide what becomes of the Black Ledger

offer_text: They will come when the watch changes, as the rota says. The rota is wrong now, but they do not know that.
Every peak sends its best to the Gate. You are not ours, but you are the one who brought the warning. Stand with us.
complete_text: The comet sails are scattered and their captain is in chains. Nine peaks owe you, and eight of them will even admit it.
A man came through here once with a river token like yours. He asked about the Trial Hall. Ask Wen about him.

entries.name: Lu's Last Page

objectives.text: Climb the Riven Peak above the Skyport Wreck
Find Lu's last page where the stars are clearest
Show the page to Trial Master Wen in the Trial Hall

offer_text: Wen keeps the names of everyone who sat the Presence Trial. Your valley man's is written there, and then crossed out.
He left something on the Riven Peak before he went home, the pirates say. They were too afraid of the stars up there to take it.
complete_text: 'I sat under eight seats and felt myself go thin as paper. I got up. The river was still in me, so I went home to it.'
He did not fail, whatever the ink says. He chose. Now it is your turn to sit.

entries.name: The Presence Trial

objectives.text: Sit beneath the empty ninth seat and bear the Presence of the other eight

offer_text: The Presence Trial is the door to Will Manifest. You cannot open it here; this land cannot hold a Will Manifest. You can earn the key.
Sage Sovereign 3, then the circle. Bring Will. Will Tempering Pills help. Stubbornness does not.
complete_text: The ninth seat looked like you, and you did not look away. That is the whole trial. Most people look away.
Your Presence is yours now. The Expanse is too small to hold what comes next. Go and ask the Launch where it points.

entries.name: Stars Beyond

objectives.text: Chart the Lantern Run from the stars over the Riven Peak
Ask Warden He where the ring points

offer_text: Navigator Sun sells the lesson for the Lantern Run to Sage Sovereigns who ask nicely. Eight readings, and the stars over the Riven Peak are clearest.
Then go to the Launch. The ring points somewhere. I have always wanted to know where.
complete_text: The ring lit when you walked up. It has not done that in two hundred years.
Out there: the Lantern Star Field. Your chart reaches it. Your road does, too, when the time comes. Not today. Soon.

entries.name: Snow for the Cabinet

objectives.text: Pick Frost Lotus on Rimefrost Heights

offer_text: Frost Lotus. Three. It only blooms where the snow never melts.
It steadies a Sage's Qi. And my prices.
complete_text: Perfect petals. Here, Storm Blood Pills, fresh from the cabinet.

entries.name: Clear Skies

objectives.text: Drive off the Azure Carp Dragonets over the Reedless Shore

offer_text: Dragonets keep spitting at my lake ferry. The sails can't take much more.
Eight of them. The rest will learn.
complete_text: The ferry thanks you. So does my budget.

entries.name: A-Lan's Herd

objectives.text: Drive the Spark Weasels away from the herd
Bring Spark Pelts for new saddle blankets

offer_text: The weasels keep stealing lightning out of the grass, and then the rhinos stampede!
Chase them off? Please?
complete_text: Grandpa says you'd make a good herder. That's the best thing he says about anyone.

entries.name: Silk on the Wind

objectives.text: Cut Kite Silk from the Wind Kites of the canyons

offer_text: The canyon wind shreds my toll flags in a week. The kites up there are made of something it can't tear.
Five lengths of their silk. The Alliance can keep its banners.
complete_text: Look at that. Not a fray. The next brigand who says he couldn't see the flag can argue with it.

entries.name: Plumes for the Bellows

objectives.text: Bring Harpy Plumes from the Harpy Roosts

offer_text: Harpy plumes hold a wind of their own. Line the bellows with them and the forge breathes like a storm.
Four will do. Kin price, of course. Meaning you fetch them.
complete_text: Hear that? The fire's roaring on its own. Take some stormsteel. It'll take a better edge now.

entries.name: Cactus Water

objectives.text: Pick Ember Cactus flowers on the Glass Dunes

offer_text: The flowers store the sun. Steep them right and the water keeps the heat out of you instead.
Four flowers. Pick them at dusk if you can. At noon they bite.
complete_text: Cactus water. Drink it before the heat and your Essence runs cool. Here, the first jars are yours.

entries.name: Glass Teeth
offer_text: Bones for the past, glass for the future. A worm's tooth shows what is coming, if you hold it to the sun.
Three teeth. The worms will not give them politely.
complete_text: Clear as water. I see... a ship with no sea. Hm. That one is yours to find, not mine.

entries.name: Stingers for the Hold
offer_text: Scorpion venom on a quenched edge. Old Ironroot trick for the desert raiders. Bring me stingers.
Five. Mind the tails.
complete_text: Good. The raiders will think twice. Here, more ore. Kin price.

entries.name: A Chart of One's Own

objectives.text: Take star readings through the sighting stones
Chart the Wreck Run at the chart table

offer_text: Sighting stones: here, on Rimefrost Summit, on the Presence Terrace. Each gives one reading every little while.
Four readings and two measures of ink. I will give you the ink for the first chart.
complete_text: Your first chart. The lines are shaky, but they go where they should. That is all a chart is.

entries.name: Keel and Ward

objectives.text: Build a Cloud Skiff on the slipway

offer_text: Six spirit wood, four stormsteel, two formation stones, three harpy plumes. Bring them, lay the keel, and I'll check your lines.
You'll need a smith's hand. Adept, at least. Hulls forgive nothing.
complete_text: She floats. On nothing, which is the point. Don't sail her anywhere you haven't charted.

entries.name: Two Breaths, One River

objectives.text: Meditate with a companion beside you

offer_text: Sage Qi is thick. Two cultivators breathing together thin it for each other. Paired cultivation, the old texts call it.
Sit with one of your companions. Breathe when they breathe. See what happens.
complete_text: Faster, yes? Keep a companion close when you sit. The river flows better with two banks.

entries.name: The Deserters

objectives.text: Bring down the rogue Nine Peaks disciples at the Broken Pier

offer_text: Some of ours ran to the comet sails. They scratch the peaks off their badges, as if that makes them someone else.
Bring the badges home. Six of them will not come quietly.
complete_text: Four badges. I'll give them back to their peaks. What the peaks do with them is their business.

entries.name: Iron from a Comet

objectives.text: Bring comet iron from the pirates' hulls

offer_text: The comet sails outrun everything in the Expanse. It's the iron: flew through a comet's tail and came out ringing.
Six ingots. I'll teach you the sloop. Two sails, comet keel. You'll need a formation master's plates too.
complete_text: Listen to it ring. Here: the sloop's lines. Half again as fast as the skiff, if your formations hold.

entries.name: Clear Skies over the Peak

objectives.text: Take star readings on the Riven Peak

offer_text: The stars over the Riven Peak are the clearest in the Expanse. The pirates say they watch you back.
Three readings from up there. I want to see if they are right.
complete_text: These are... very clear. Hm. Keep your chart close up there.

entries.name: Blood Remembers

objectives.text: Kneel before the Ironroot tablets in the Ancestor Hall

offer_text: Kin by adoption is kin. But the blood still has to learn to hear you. Kneel before the tablets.
And grow. The Blood Dao listens to Sovereigns. Come back when you are one.
complete_text: There. Feel it? Every Ironroot who ever lived, in the beat under your ribs. That is the Blood Dao. It is yours now.

entries.name: What the Bones Say

objectives.text: Bring shards of the Terracotta Wardens, who died and did not die

offer_text: The wardens were men once. Then clay. Then something that remembers being men. Bring me what is left of three.
I will show you the line between living and not. It is thinner than you think, and it moves.
complete_text: Hold this shard. Warm, yes? The Life and Death Dao begins where you stop being sure which side it is on.

entries.name: The Sound of Snow

objectives.text: Quiet the Snow Apes on their ledges
Sit in silence in the hermit's ice cave

offer_text: The apes are loud. Quiet them. Then sit here, with me, until you can hear what you feel.
complete_text: There. Every feeling has a sound. The Emotion Dao is only listening. You were loud for a long time.
